facts.clause: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.
The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.
Nunu and Willump can Recast to let the snowball go early.
When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.
dealing […] magic damage per snowball and Slowing enemies hit
Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.
Nunu and Willump also gain […] Shield for the duration before decaying over […] seconds afterwards.
Nunu and Willump can Recast to end the blizzard early.
